name: omnicore
description: Tooling for the omnicore DDD + CQRS framework: scaffold a new service, decompose a whole-system/MVP description into a domain map and scaffold it entity by entity, add/evolve/remove CRUD entities, create and evolve read-side views, wire framework capabilities (gRPC surface, external API calls, cache, integration events, …) docs-first, run the service with clickable links, diagnose a misbehaving service, upgrade the framework pin, and ask docs-first questions.
